# 1 Clement Chapter 52 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 52 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_052_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 52

**52:1** Brothers, the Lord has no need of anything from any person; he requires nothing from any quarter; but he is pleased when he is acknowledged. For the holy David says:

**52:2** "I will acknowledge the LORD, and that will please him more than a young calf growing its horns and hooves.

**52:3** Let the poor take note and be glad."

**52:4** And again he says: "Offer to God a sacrifice of praise, and fulfill your vows to the Most High. Call upon me in the day of your affliction, and I will rescue you, and you shall give glory to me."

**52:5** "For the sacrifice acceptable to God is a contrite spirit."

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
